items.title: Frontier risk and preparedness
items.summary: To support the safety of highly-capable AI systems, we are developing our approach to catastrophic risk preparedness, including building a Preparedness team and launching a challenge.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI宣布建立前沿风险防范机制，组建专门的Preparedness团队来追踪、评估和防范生物、网络等前沿AI带来的灾难性风险，并推出相应的挑战赛来收集安全防御方案。原始信息显示：To support the safety of highly-capable AI systems, we are developing our approach to catastrophic risk preparedness, including building a Preparedness team and launching a challenge.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Frontier risk and preparedness”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI宣布成立防范团队并建立前沿AI系统的灾难性风险应对框架。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
